payload.rule: Identity, memory, canon, provenance, tools, approvals and evals must remain outside replaceable model weights.

locks.name: Offline means no hidden cloud fallback

payload.rule: Strict offline mode must fail closed when a required local service is unavailable. Never silently route to a cloud model.
Keep Z-Earth standalone. Do not speculate about or fold it into larger projects unless explicitly requested.
Prefer current free open-source software and openly licensed data; avoid mandatory API keys, paid tokens and cloud runtime dependencies.
Vehicles in the active future action language are hover vehicles; do not substitute conventional old-world vehicles unless scene canon explicitly requires it.
Kozy is human engineer / Dy's former best friend. Do not use sources that describe Kozy as sleepy or a droid.
